title: Report an issue
covers: Report an issue from any screen

steps.say: When something is wrong, anyone signed in can report it from any screen. No email - the report and its answer stay inside the portal. This is the Reported issues screen, where the answer comes from.
A reader on Katha opens their account menu and picks Report an issue. It works the same on every screen of every portal.
A short header, what went wrong, and a screenshot if it helps - browse, drop or paste. The screen it came from is attached on its own.

do.text: Listen does not start on one chapter
On The Kite Seller, pressing Listen on chapter two shows the spinner but no sound plays.

steps.say: Send report. It lands in Reported issues, under the reader's own account, and the menu shows a count for whoever answers reports.
Back in SimplyFile, the portal admin sees the new report at the top of Reported issues - who sent it, from where, and what is wrong.
They open it, read it with its screenshot, write a reply the reader will see, and resolve it.

do.text: Thank you - chapter two had a broken voice file. It plays now.

steps.say: The next time the reader opens the portal, the answer is waiting as a banner at the top. No email, nothing to look for.
And every report, with its status and answer, stays in the account menu under My reports and feedback - next to the feedback they sent on any work.
Report an issue and work feedback are one framework. Every limit, every status and who may answer live in chips the owner can change.
